PR10: pin the dyn-workflow Flutter SDK and post the full commit SHA

The downstream run installed the latest stable Flutter (3.44.8) while the
workspace pins 3.41.4 via .fvmrc, so the committed baseline goldens failed
rasterization on every run. Setup Flutter now reads flutter-version-file:
.fvmrc, so CI uses exactly the SDK the goldens were generated with. The
conclusion status was also rejected because commit.txt records the short
SHA; the verify step now resolves the full object id for the status API.
